assumptions.statement: Official polygons for the three scope levels (coordinated research, overall design, key areas) are not publicly available; the package currently uses provisional boundaries derived from the official announcement text and area values.
assumptions.statement_zh: 三层范围（统筹研究、总体设计、重点区域）的官方 polygon 未公开发布；本包暂用依据公告文字四至与面积推定的临时边界。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 临时边界不得作为官方红线、审批依据或精确面积结论；面积复算偏差约 0.02%-0.43%，所有空间落点需按待校准理解。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方三层范围 polygon 发布后，重新投影到 EPSG:4548 复算 site_boundary、land_use、metrics 与全部图表。

assumptions.statement: Official KEY_AREA polygons for the three key detailed-design areas are not available; provisional rectangles (众智园/原点社区/大钟寺) are used only for intake, visualization, and design discussion.
assumptions.statement_zh: 三处重点区（众智园、原点社区、大钟寺）的官方 KEY_AREA polygon 未发布；临时矩形仅用于方案生成、展示与讨论，不代表地块边界。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 重点区只能做方向性详细设计表达，不得用于精确面积与红线主张；详细设计深度结论待官方片区边界确认。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方 KEY_AREA polygon 发布后替换 key_areas.geojson 并重算三区面积、land_use 细分与详细设计图。

assumptions.statement: Regulatory detailed planning conditions (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setbacks) are missing from the public site package; no statutory intensity figures are claimed.
assumptions.statement_zh: 官方控规条件（容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度、绿地率、退线）未公开；方案不主张任何法定强度指标。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 开发强度、建筑规模、高度分区与退线只能作为待确认条件表述；metrics.floor_area_ratio 标记 unknown。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方控规/规划条件发布后，逐地块复算开发强度与规模指标并更新 metric 状态。

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines and cross-sections are not available; road centerlines in the package are conceptual alignments for structure discussion only.
assumptions.statement_zh: 官方道路红线与断面未发布；roads.geojson 中的道路中心线仅为概念线位，用于结构讨论。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 道路微循环、慢行断点与站点接驳只能做概念组织；road_ratio 标记 unknown。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方道路红线与断面发布后，更新 roads.geojson 并重算路网长度、路网密度与慢行贯通率。

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries and ownership status are not available; the retain/renovate/demolish strategy is described only as conceptual tiers without parcel-level conclusions.
assumptions.statement_zh: 地块边界与权属状态未公开；拆改留仅作保留/改造/新建三档概念策略，不给地块级结论。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 更新项目清单只能写概念分区与待核条件；不得擅自指定拆改留或改造权属空间。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方地籍/宗地资料补齐后，逐地块核验拆改留与更新项目落位。

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprint, height, use, and construction-year data are not available; buildings.geojson contains only 18 illustrative footprints.
assumptions.statement_zh: 现状建筑轮廓、高度、用途与建成年代未公开；buildings.geojson 仅含 18 处概念示意基底。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 建筑更新、风貌与容量判断只能作为概念指引；不得编造建筑高度或现状底数。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方现状调查/清权测绘发布后，替换 buildings.geojson 并重算建筑基底面积与密度。

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection control extents for the Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park and Qinghuayuan Station site are not available; constraints.geojson marks only a conceptual location.
assumptions.statement_zh: 京张铁路遗址公园与清华园车站旧址的文保控制范围未公开；constraints.geojson 仅标注概念位置。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 文化与公共空间设计保持保守；朝圣地标不得表述为已批准建设。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方文保控制范围发布后，更新 constraints.geojson 并复核地标与公共空间落位。

assumptions.statement: Municipal utility, fire, flood-control, and sponge-city conditions are not available; municipal strategy is limited to system-level concept recommendations.
assumptions.statement_zh: 市政管线、消防、防洪排涝与海绵条件未公开；市政策略仅做体系级概念建议。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 不得给出管线迁改或消防通道工程结论；算力驿站等新型基础设施仅作概念布置。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方市政专项/管线资料发布后，复核新型基础设施布局与市政承载。

assumptions.statement: Public service facility inventory is not available; service strategy is described as a system and pending-facility checklist rather than confirmed facilities.
assumptions.statement_zh: 公共服务设施底数未公开；公服策略仅作体系与待核设施清单，不编造学校、医疗等设施现状。
assumptions.impact_if_missing: 人才生活服务与 AI+ 公共服务场景只能作为概念供给；不得编造设施分布。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: 官方公共服务设施数据发布后，复核公服覆盖与服务场景落位。
